name: Twin Rail refinement
prompt: Refine this exact Twin Rail blaster design for Math on Mars. Preserve its identity: one compact shoulder-mounted sci-fi blaster with EXACTLY TWO parallel squared-off rail barrels, off-white outer armor, navy recessed rails, cyan rectangular muzzles, orange swept dorsal fin, thick clean dark cartoon outlines. Keep the same approximately 30-degree elevated three-quarter camera aiming screen-right, whole object, centered on flat bright green background. Improve the silhouette and intentional design: shorten and tighten the rear receiver so the twin rails dominate; make both barrel housings matching and precisely aligned, with bold angular chamfered off-white nose frames around two clearly distinct cyan rectangular apertures. A clean open gap separates the barrels. Give the rails a subtle forward taper and a single large navy inset per barrel. Make the orange dorsal fin LOWER and swept backward like a compact spaceship stabilizer, integrated smoothly into the receiver instead of a tall sail. Replace the orange circular side patch with one bold short orange forward chevron. Keep the rear navy hinge simple and slightly smaller. Integrate a compact sturdy underside shoulder-mount bracket, no pistol grip. A few big well-balanced shapes, sleek but chunky and friendly, readable at tiny gameplay size. Flatten shading: solid base colors, only one simple hard-edged shadow where necessary, NO glare, shine, gradients, reflective bevels, glow halos, tiny panel lines, bolts, vents or texture. No extra barrels, weapons, ammo, projectiles, hands, character, lettering, logo, floor or cast shadow. This is a polished iteration of the supplied design, not a different weapon. Square source image with generous margin around the complete asset.
review_notes: Smaller swept fin, orange chevron, more compact receiver and mount. Some multi-tone shading remains. No gameplay-size or animation verification.
